name: Eoptolink Technology Inc., Ltd.
blurb: Eoptolink Technology Inc., Ltd. is a China-based company engaged in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of optical modules for optical communication applications. Its products include high-speed optical modules, silicon optical modules, coherent optical modules, and 800G LPO optical modules, serving markets such as 5G wireless networks, fixed broadband, data centers, and telecommunications. The company has a market capitalization of over 500 billion CNY and is a key player in the optical communication equipment sector.
recent: In the past 30 days, Eoptolink's stock price has shown significant volatility, with a 52-week range of 63.32 to 627.80 CNY. The company reported strong financial results with revenue of 29.13B CNY and net income of 10.74B CNY, representing year-over-year growth of over 150%. The stock has gained more than 600% over the past year, driven by demand for high-speed optical modules in AI and data center applications.
